description: Removes what lies under rectangles of the pages, and every place where a text stands, from the file itself and not just from view: text, the pixels of images under a rectangle, and links and comments it touches. The result is read again: a text that can still be found fails the call with redaction_incomplete, which names rectangles and texts by their number, and nothing is delivered. Rectangles are points from the top-left corner of the page as a viewer shows it, 72 to an inch; get_pdf_info gives the page sizes and pdf_to_image a picture of the page. A text is found whatever its spacing, ignoring case unless match_case is true. A black box is drawn over each removed place, another colour with fill, none with fill null. Pass exactly one PDF: source, a render or library file of the workspace; path, a file on this machine; or file_base64. Starter plan and above; 0.5 units on a live key. The texts are never stored.

file_base64.description: The PDF itself, base64 encoded, up to 20 MB; sent with the request and not kept

file_name.description: Name of the PDF given as file_base64 or path, e.g. contract.pdf; the results are named after it

filename.description: Name of the file behind download_url; the source's name when left out

fill.description: Colour of the box drawn over each removed place, #000000 when left out; null draws none

match_case.description: Find a text only in the case it is written in

path.description: Absolute path of a PDF on this machine, up to 100 MB; sent with the request and not kept

regions.description: The rectangles to remove, as a viewer shows the page; give regions, text or both

source.description: A PDF of the workspace: the rnd_ id of a PDF render, or a PDF of the file library by name (such as terms.pdf) or fil_ id

text.description: Texts to remove wherever they stand, such as a name or an IBAN, found whatever their spacing

whole_words.description: Find a text only where a word boundary stands on each side

name: redact_pdf

accessibility.description: The PDF/UA-1 verdict, when the template declares it

download_url.description: Signed link to the file; null until the render succeeded

einvoice.description: The e-invoice report, when the render made one

expires_at.description: When download_url stops working; get_render issues a fresh one

form.description: What fill_pdf_form did: the fields filled, those left out (unknown name or invalid value) and those whose calculation or display format no viewer ran

output.description: The format of the file: pdf, png, jpg, webp, docx or pptx, or zip for the several files of split_pdf and pdf_to_image

pdfa.description: The PDF/A verdict (PDF/A-2b or PDF/A-3b), when the template declares it

template.description: The template and version rendered; null for html and conversions

title: Redact a PDF
